caption: The drawing depicts a single, irregularly shaped object resembling a seashell. The shell is predominantly light brown with yellow and beige highlights, and has smooth, sweeping curves with a rounded, somewhat bulbous base and a flared, hat-like rim that curves upward on one side. The coloring includes gradations and shading to indicate form and texture, with distinct lighter and darker areas suggesting reflection and shadow. Near the bottom center of the main drawing, the spiral pattern at the base of the shell is visible. In the upper left corner of the drawing, a smaller, inset version of the same shell appears, surrounded by a rectangular border and shown from a different angle. Below the smaller shell image, a small horizontal double-line scale appears. The background is plain and off-white. The artist’s signature, "Yolande DeLasser," is written in the lower right corner of the sheet.
title: Glass Hat
